tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Mikrotik hEX S E60iUGS (2025 Version) – 2.5G SFP Port Router

Upgrade your home or office network with the Mikrotik hEX S E60iUGS (2025 Version), a high-performance router designed for fast, reliable connectivity. Perfect for small to medium businesses and advanced home networks in Bangladesh, it combines multiple Gigabit Ethernet ports with a high-speed 2.5G SFP port for fiber uplinks.

Key Features:

  • 5 × Gigabit Ethernet Ports: Includes PoE-in on port #1 and PoE-out on port #5.
  • 1 × 2.5G SFP Port: Supports high-speed fiber connections.
  • USB 3.0 Port: Connect storage devices or LTE modems.
  • Dual-Core ARM CPU (950 MHz): Efficient processing for smooth network performance.
  • 512 MB DDR3 RAM & 128 MB NAND Storage: Ensures stable operations and multitasking.
  • RouterOS v7, License Level 4: Advanced networking features including VLANs, bonding, traffic shaping, and VPN support.
  • Compact Metal Case with Passive Cooling: Silent and durable design.

Power & Consumption:

  • DC Jack Input: 12–57V DC
  • PoE-In: 18–57V (802.3af/at)
  • PoE-Out: Passive PoE up to 57V on port #5
  • Max Power Consumption: 23W
  • Environmental & Certifications:
  • Operating Temperature: -40°C to 70°C
  • Certifications: CE, EAC, RoHS
  • IP Rating: IP20

Dimensions:

  • Size: 113 × 89 × 28 mm
